anthropic.label: Anthropic (Claude)

reject.message: That is an Admin API key, which manages your whole organization. Create a regular API key instead.

steps: Sign in to the Claude Console. If you're new, add a payment method or credits under Settings › Billing.
Open Settings › API keys and choose Create key.
Name it after this project so you can find it later, for example “Aludel · {project}”.
Choose an expiration. 30 days is a good start; you'll get an email before it runs out.
Set Linked account to yourself (a personal key). Use a service account if a team will share this project.
Copy the key (it starts with sk-ant-) and paste it below. The Console shows it only once.
anthropic.limits: Set a monthly spend limit under Settings › Billing › Spend limits so a runaway agent can't overspend. Requests stop with an error when the limit is reached.

openai.label: OpenAI

reject.message: That is an Admin key, which manages your whole organization. Create a project API key instead.

steps: Sign in to the OpenAI platform. If you're new, add credits under Settings › Billing.
Create a project for this app (optional, but it keeps spending and keys separate).
Open API keys and choose Create new secret key, in that project.
Name it after this project, for example “Aludel · {project}”, with All permissions (agents need to call models).
Copy the key (it starts with sk-) and paste it below. OpenAI shows it only once.
openai.limits: In the project's settings, open Limits and set a monthly spend limit with Enforce a hard limit turned on. Requests fail with an error once the limit is reached.
